desc: Parse p into pre, mid, post by locating the two '*' indices; note each part may be empty.
Design combination logic: greedy earliest mid/post per pre-start via binary search is optimal (disjoint ordered occurrences).
Implement KMP prefix function and matcher returning all start indices (empty pattern → list(range(n+1))).
Build occurrence lists A, B, C and run the bisect-based sweep to compute the minimum length.
Verify against all four examples and edge cases (p="**" → 0; s="aaa", p="a*a*a" → 3; no-match → −1); confirm O((n+m) log n) complexity; deliver final code in starter format.
